short_description: Procedural geomorphology derived from accepted G7 semantic fields and G3/G5/G6 surface, feature and hydrology truth.
purpose: Add deterministic valley, river-channel, bank, floodplain and erosion/deposition shaping without taking ownership of persistent Matter mutations, world identity, authority, persistence or material ontology.
expected_outcome: A replaceable, provenance-friendly geomorphology layer that produces stable surface deformation independent from SurfaceCellKey, LOD, camera and representation and can later feed geology/volume/detail stages.
progress_note: G8.0 Geomorphology Contracts remains ACCEPTED after exact-Windows full acceptance on head 7a34c5d58b5a766fd8f4da46073dfcea29673fe9 with world/core regression through NX4 PASS and CLEAN working tree. G8.1 valley runtime remains the same replaceable formula valley_delta_m = -valley_max_depth_m * pow(valley_influence, valley_exponent). The first Windows focused attempt on 5de8716fc5b2893e00d31f109b73d0974891aca9 stopped before the G8.1 runtime test because the inherited G8.0 regression still expected the pre-acceptance manifest status IMPLEMENTED_CANDIDATE and still treated river/fluid fields as G8.1 planned inputs. FIX1 is test-harness only: 92406530 updates the G8.0 parent regression to validate ACCEPTED evidence plus the split between two G8.1 valley inputs and three future river/fluid inputs; e9c5073 allows that exact parent-regression test change in the G8.1 full-acceptance scope. next_stage: Sync the FIX1 head, rerun RUN_G8_1_VALLEY_INCISION_TESTS.ps1, and if green run RUN_G8_1_FULL_ACCEPTANCE.ps1 on the same clean checkout without fetch/reset. Only a full PASS unlocks G8.2 River Channel Incision.
